title: Akki Rotti - Thottaratti
description: Paper-thin coastal rice flatbreads cooked with soaked raw rice paste, grated coconut, shallots, and spicy red chillies on an oiled kadai.

steps.instruction: Soak raw rice for 2 hours, then grind to a silky smooth batter with minimal water.
Separately grind coconut, shallots, dried red chillies, and curry leaves; blend into the ground rice.
Add water to bring the batter to a thin, watery neer-dosa style consistency.
In a seasoned iron pan or kadai, smear a few drops of coconut oil, pour a ladle of batter, and swirl quickly to the outer rim.
Drizzle a few drops of coconut oil along the edges.
Cover with a lid and cook for 1 minute on medium. Remove lid; cook open for another 30 seconds.
The rotti will curl and naturally release from the pan. Fold and serve hot.

storyOrOrigin: A beloved coastal Malabar and Karnataka heirloom breakfast, paper-thin, laced with subtle coconut sweetness and aroma.
grandmasSecrets: The batter must be thin and watery so it swirls effortlessly around the curved kadai.
